sentences.text: The meeting was the first session for a project team developing a new remote control, intended to be original, user-friendly, and accessible to a wide range of ages including grannies and children.
The team conducted an icebreaker activity involving drawing animals on a whiteboard to generate ideas for the product's design.
The group discussed the project plan, functional and conceptual design stages, and reviewed the proposed selling price and production costs.
Participant B (Sarah) introduced herself as the project manager and outlined the agenda, which includes getting to know each other, tool training, and discussing the project plan.
Participant B stated that the project aims to develop a remote control that is original, trendy, appealing to a wide market, user-friendly, and usable by grannies, kids, and even dogs.
Participant B explained the project structure, noting that the team will first do functional design, then conceptual design, and finally detailed design.
During the icebreaker, Participant B drew a tiger and described it as majestic, independent, and proud.
Participant A drew a cat, noting it was sitting down and described it as supportive, loyal, and having intuition.
Participant D drew a shape that initially looked like a beak but was later identified as a crocodile, which Participant D described as scary, strong, and independent.
Participant C drew a shape intended to be an eagle but struggled with the pen, eventually describing it as intrepid and noting that birds of prey are free-spirited.
Participant B mentioned that the team's experience with universal remote controls involved programming devices, though signals often lost and required re-programming.
Participant B expressed a dislike for remote controls with too many tiny buttons and words, and for symbols that are not necessarily understood.
Participant C suggested incorporating an LCD display with a menu system, similar to mobile phones, to make navigation easier.
No decisions were agreed upon during the meeting.
Participant B will pull up the meeting notes or put them in a shared folder for later reference.
